# LRM 2.7: "A string literal is a sequence of characters enclosed by double
# quotes and contained on a single line", and Table 2-2 lists no \<newline>
# escape. The continuation is an IEEE 1800 SystemVerilog addition (5.9);
# Verilog-AMS derives from IEEE 1364-2005 (1.1), whose 3.6 has the same
# single-line rule. Verbatim from bsim4va.va:3658 -- a vendor extension, not
# a lexer gap, so the rejection is the correct answer and is pinned here.
ParseError
E0138
a string literal may not span lines
